tools.name: bondterminal_riesgo_pais
tools.description: Return the current Argentina country-risk spread and deltas, with optional history. YTM conventions are percent, spreads are basis points, and bond prices are per 100 face. Explicit history is capped at 730 days and 750 returned points. Billing: current snapshot is free; including history costs 1 re

tools.name: bondterminal_treasury_curve
tools.description: Return the current US Treasury curve across 11 standard tenors. Rates and YTM conventions are percent, spreads are basis points, and bond prices are per 100 face. The response is capped at the 11 listed tenors. Billing: free; consumes no calculation or read units.

tools.name: bondterminal_get_usage
tools.description: Return the authenticated plan, calculation/read usage, remaining quotas, and reset time. YTM conventions are percent, spreads are basis points, and bond prices are per 100 face; this tool returns no bond data and has no batch input. Billing: free; consumes no calculation or read units.

tools.name: bondterminal_request_bond
tools.description: Request that BondTerminal add a bond it does not cover yet. Call only after the user agreed. Use the ISIN from a bondterminal_get_bonds miss.

tools.name: bondterminal_report_gap
tools.description: Report a gap in BondTerminal when you could not complete the user's request: a needed tool or field is missing, a result looks wrong, or a tool description was unclear. Call it at most once per distinct problem per conversation. Do not call it for searches you can fix by retrying or by using bondter
